q: What should a cable maker ask a Chilean copper smelter about its Scope 1?
title: Chilean copper smelter: Scope 1 data
short: Ask for fuel burnt in smelting and converting, carbon in fluxes and reductants, and how sulphur captured as acid was handled, per tonne of anode or cathode. Smelting concentrate releases relatively little CO2 itself; fuel and power drive most of the figure.
audience: Cable and wire makers buying copper anode or cathode from Chilean smelters

ul: Natural gas, diesel or fuel oil for furnaces and converters.
Coal or coke used as reductant.

p: Electricity for refining is Scope 2 for the smelter. Sulphuric acid made from off gas is a co product; ask how emissions were split.
All of it is your Scope 3, category 1. Ask for the year and boundary with the figure.
